assumptions.mortality: Declining age-specific mortality under the published 2024 method; not a constant mortality-rate assumption.

territory_and_history: Source series retain their historical definitions. No claim of constant territorial borders across 1850–2025. Source 12dx notes that 1891–1939 figures use the resident-population correction made in 1949. No independent historical-border harmonisation is performed.
regional_geography: 11ra uses the 1 January 2026 regional classification throughout the retrieved 1990–2025 series. This is not a history of contemporary administrative borders.
shock_interpretation: Source table annotations are contextual labels, not estimates of attributable mortality, migration or causal effect.
not_measured: health or care needs from age alone
labour supply or employment from working-age population alone
fiscal sustainability from demographic dependency ratio
migration causes from regional age distributions
ethnicity or indigenous identity from language or birthplace
